create_StochasticDropout: create a stochastic dropout layer that randomly masks elements with a configurable drop rate and shares masks across specified axes
build_DisabledDropout: build a disabled dropout layer as a no-op placeholder that can be re-enabled into a stochastic dropout layer
test_maybe_dropout: test the maybe_dropout factory function that returns StochasticDropout or DisabledDropout based on whether drop_rate is None
refactor_StochasticDropout_disable: refactor a StochasticDropout instance to a DisabledDropout using its disable method to turn off dropout at runtime
review_DisabledDropout_enable: review the DisabledDropout enable method that reconstructs a StochasticDropout with the original drop rate and share_across_axes
